tools.name: reeling_get_platform_matrix
tools.description: PUBLIC DISCOVERY TOOL (No API key required): Returns Reeling's 15 supported social and community platforms, authentication methods (Direct OAuth 2.0 vs free Reeling Companion Chrome Extension), file/character limits, and pricing tiers.

tools.name: reeling_check_spam_score
tools.description: PUBLIC DISCOVERY TOOL (No API key required): Evaluates a draft title and post body against Reeling's Pre-Publish Spam & AutoModerator Shield for Reddit, Quora, Medium, LinkedIn, or X. Returns a 0–100 safety_score, specific trigger explanations, auto-sanitized copy, and a shareable verification badge

tools.name: reeling_list_projects
tools.description: List all projects / workspaces available in your reeling.app account.

tools.name: reeling_list_channels
tools.description: List all connected social media channels (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Bluesky, Threads, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Discord, Telegram, etc.) with account details, usernames, and statuses.

tools.name: reeling_publish_post
tools.description: Publish or schedule short-form videos, articles, and posts across multiple social platforms simultaneously (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Threads, Bluesky, Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Medium, Quora, Reddit).

tools.name: reeling_discover_community_questions
tools.description: Discover daily Reddit threads and Quora questions matching target keywords & subreddits, and check the account's safe Cadence Guard counters (max 3 answers/day & max 3 top-level posts/week).

tools.name: reeling_draft_community_answer
tools.description: Draft a value-first, humanized community reply for X, Reddit (100% Reply-Only), or Quora using Stealth Anti-Sell Mention, Smart Mix, or 100% Pure Karma Help.

tools.name: reeling_schedule_community_autopilot
tools.description: Schedule 3 daily Reply-Only Reddit comments per day on autopilot (default 7 days = 21 replies: 1 Pure Karma + 2 Hidden Anti-Sell Mentions/day) across target subreddits and keywords.

tools.name: reeling_humanize_content
tools.description: Run Reeling's 2-Pass Wikipedia 24-Pattern AI Slop Humanizer on a social or community draft to strip AI tells, SaaS-bro phrases, em-dashes, and air-quotes.

tools.name: reeling_get_channel_options
tools.description: Retrieve publishing options for a connected channel, such as Pinterest boards (ID, name, privacy) or TikTok creator configurations.

tools.name: reeling_get_post_status
tools.description: Retrieve delivery and publishing status for a post across all targeted social networks.

tools.name: reeling_get_analytics
tools.description: Retrieve aggregated performance analytics across all connected platforms (views, likes, comments, impressions, platform breakdown, and top-performing posts).

tools.name: reeling_sync_metrics
tools.description: Trigger an on-demand real-time metric sync against live APIs (YouTube, Bluesky, Instagram, Threads, TikTok).

tools.name: reeling_evaluate_content_jev
tools.description: Run a Type-Safe JEV (Judgment & Evaluation Vector) diagnostic on published post metrics. Evaluates 0-3s hook velocity, cognitive concept fit, visual/code density, engagement triggers, and drop-off causes with Zod schema validation, returning actionable content prescriptions for future generations.

tools.name: reeling_get_inbox
tools.description: Fetch the unified social inbox containing audience comments and feedback across YouTube, Bluesky, Instagram, Threads, and TikTok.

tools.name: reeling_reply_to_comment
tools.description: Send a direct reply to a comment on a social network (YouTube, Bluesky, Instagram, Threads, TikTok).

tools.name: reeling_adapt_content_ai
tools.description: Use Reeling's AI content adapter to transform a single hook, script, or topic into platform-tailored copy for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Threads, and Bluesky.

tools.name: reeling_generate_video
tools.description: Generate short-form video clips in seconds using fal.ai MiniMax H3 Max and Video-01 text-to-video AI models. Automatically saves the video to Cloudflare R2 storage and returns the public media URL ready for publishing to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, etc.

tools.name: reeling_create_storyboard
tools.description: Generate an AI multi-scene storyboard (from 30 seconds up to 5 minutes) broken into sequential 5-second cinematic cuts with timecodes, scene titles, camera movements, and audio/foley cues.

tools.name: reeling_stitch_storyboard
tools.description: Render each scene in a storyboard via fal.ai MiniMax H3 and stitch them into a single continuous MP4 video with FFmpeg, uploading the final result to Cloudflare R2 storage.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: reeling_check_spam_score, reeling_list_channels, reeling_discover_community_questions, reeling_get_post_status, reeling_get_analytics, reeling_get_inbox · Private data: reeling_get_platform_matrix, reeling_check_spam_score · Public sink: reeling_check_spam_score, reeling_publish_post, reeling_get_post_status, reeling_evaluate_content_jev, reeling_reply_to_comment · Destructive: reeling_humanize_content, reeling_evaluate_content_jev.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: reeling_check_spam_score, reeling_list_channels, reeling_discover_community_questions, reeling_get_post_status, reeling_get_analytics, reeling_get_inbox · Private data: reeling_get_platform_matrix, reeling_check_spam_score · Public sink: reeling_check_spam_score, reeling_publish_post, reeling_get_post_status, reeling_evaluate_content_jev, reeling_reply_to_comment · Destructive: reeling_humanize_content, reeling_evaluate_content_jev

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "reeling_draft_community_answer" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Draft a value-first, non-spammy answer for a Reddit thread or Quora question, verified by Reeling's Spam Shield." → after: "Draft a value-first, humanized community reply for X, Reddit (100% Reply-Only), or Quora using Stealth Anti-Sell Mention, Smart Mix, or 100% Pure Karma Help."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
